title: Festivals of India
description: Nobody celebrates like India — Holi's colors, Diwali's million lamps, and streets full of music and joy. #festival #holi #diwali #india

scenes.text: Nobody on Earth celebrates like India.
Holi, where an entire country throws color into the sky.
Diwali, when millions of lamps turn the night into gold.
Streets that overflow with music, dance, and fireworks.
Every festival is a reason to gather, share, and glow.
In India, joy is never celebrated quietly.
